{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Metal Goat|kanji=辛未|romaji=kanoto hitsuji|onyomi=shimmu|p=xīnwèi|w=hsin-wei|mi=ɕin⁵³ weɪ̯⁵³|y=san1 mei6|j=san1 mei6|ci=sɐn mei²|mc=sin mjɨjH|oc-bs=sin məɯʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Metal Goat''' (辛未, ''kanoto hitsuji''; onyomi ''shimmu'') is the 8th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 8th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Metal Horse|ja|庚午|1=Yang Metal Horse}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Water Monkey|ja|壬申|1=Yang Water Monkey}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''辛'' is Yin Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''未'' (Goat) is Yin Earth; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Metal Goat (辛未)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): xīnwèi
** Cantonese (Jyutping): san1 mei6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kanoto-hitsuji
*** On'yomi: shimmu
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): sinmi (신미)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Tân Mùi

A {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year that leaves a remainder of 11 when divided by 60 is a year of Yin Metal Goat (辛未).

==Months of Yin Metal Goat==
In a Gregorian year where the last digit is 4 or 9 (corresponding to {{ill|Jiǎ|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jiǎ}} or {{ill|Jǐ|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jǐ}} in the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}}), the {{ill|June|en|June|qid=Q120|lt=6th Month|1=June}} is a Xīnwèi month. However, in certain cases, the calculation is based on the {{ill|Lunar Calendar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunar Calendar}} or the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term|1=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Xiaoshu|en|Xiaoshu|qid=Q1190976|lt=Lesser Heat|1=Xiaoshu}} to the day before {{ill|Liqiu|en|Liqiu|qid=Q1147421|lt=Beginning of Autumn|1=Liqiu}}).

==Days of Yin Metal Goat==
Xīnwèi days have specific meanings in the {{ill|Selected Days|ja|選日|1=Senjitsu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Selected Days}} system.

=== Selected Days ===
A Xīnwèi day is the second day of the {{ill|Great Earth Period|ja|犯土|lt=大土|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Great Earth Period|1=Tsuchi (Japanese term)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}}.
